account.description: Identifier of the account the membership belongs to: an existing account or one created by this acceptance.

active.description: Whether the membership is active; an acceptance always writes an active one.

source.description: The membership's source; an acceptance always writes invite.

sso_exempt.description: Whether the membership is exempt from SSO enforcement; an acceptance writes false.

tenant.description: The alias of the tenant the membership was written in.

AuthnInviteInvitation.description: One invitation as the management face shows it. It never carries the acceptance token.

accepted_at.description: The zero instant 0001-01-01T00:00:00Z when the invitation has not been accepted

created_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC of issuance.

expires_at.description: RFC 3339 deadline in UTC; a pending invitation at or past it can no longer be accepted.

id.description: The invitation's opaque identifier, used to revoke it.

invited_by.description: The account identifier of the issuer; empty when a host command issued the invitation without an HTTP identity.

status.description: The stored state. Expiry is not stored: an expired pending invitation still reads pending.

tenant.description: The alias of the tenant the invitation grants a membership in.

AuthnInviteView.description: The answer of the acceptance read: the invitation a token points to.

invitation.description: The invitation the token points to, without its token.

Problem.description: An RFC 9457 problem document. This is the entry point's default error shape, which a host-supplied ErrorResponder may replace.

detail.description: A longer explanation of this occurrence, present only when the answering module has one to give. It may be a sentence rendered in the request language or a language-neutral token such as "forbidden", so clients must not parse it.

instance.description: A URI identifying this occurrence; absent when there is none to give.

status.description: The HTTP status code the response is written with, repeated from the status line.

title.description: A short summary of the kind of problem. A module that sets none gets the standard English status text for the status code.

type.description: The machine-readable code identifying the kind of problem. A module that sets none gets the RFC 9457 default about:blank; codes this platform defines are URNs of the form urn:speed:<capability>:<code>.

get.description: Resolves the token's SHA-256 to an invitation and returns its view so a client can show what it is about to accept. The route is public and the token is the whole credential; the response never carries a token. An unknown token is 404. The view reflects the stored state even when the invitation can no longer be accepted, so the client should read status and expires_at rather than assume the link is redeemable.

parameters.description: The acceptance token, prefixed spd_inv_, which identifies the invitation and is the whole credential on this public route.
parameters.name: token

get.summary: Read the invitation a token points to

post.description: Redeems the invitation and writes a membership whose source is invite. When the invited address already belongs to an account, the membership is added to it and username, display_name and password are ignored; otherwise an enabled user account is created first, with the address verified through the invitation and the username as its login name. A request that creates an account without a username is 400. Two concurrent redemptions of one token leave at most one winner. A token that is expired, revoked or already accepted is 409.

parameters.description: The acceptance token, prefixed spd_inv_, which identifies the invitation and is the whole credential on this public route.
parameters.name: token

schema.description: The acceptance request; the body fields are read only when the invited address has no account.

display_name.description: Display name of the account created when the invited address has no account; ignored when the address already belongs to one.

password.description: Initial password of the account created when the invited address has no account; ignored when the address already belongs to one.

username.description: Login name of the account created when the invited address has no account; required then, and ignored when the address already belongs to one.

requestBody.description: The username, display name and initial password used only when the invited address has no account yet.

409.description: The username the acceptance would open the account with is already taken

413.description: The request body is over the endpoint's limit

415.description: The request body is not application/json

post.summary: Redeem an invitation, creating the account when the address has none
